name: Crumbs Left Behind
source:
Play as Marguerite, the bride left at the alter, as she makes her way out of the cookie jar to find her missing fiance Finn. 

However, she isn't the only one looking for him... Finn's personal knight, Sir Theodore, is also on the quest to locate the missing prince.

AND! AND! AND! Everyone's favorite societal outcast, Gina, is here to guide the two along their journey!

Bickering, truths revealed, secrets unearthered, and self discovery is what one might expect to find as they travel to the land of granite countertops and five limbed monstrosities! It is up to you to decide what's best. It is up to you to make the choice of whether to stay or to let go...
